name: reply-to-thread
description: Replies at once to a Gmail conversation. Provide a threadId from gmail__search-messages and a plain-text body. Set replyAll to include the conversation’s other recipients. To save a reply without sending, use gmail__create-draft with a threadId instead.

threadId.description: Thread ID from gmail__search-messages or gmail__get-message.

replyAll.description: Also reply to the last message's To and Cc recipients, excluding your own address.
